commands.name: unstuck
commands.help: Recover selected eligible mobile units, or your main character when nothing is selected. Use 'all' for active units in the current region.

commands.name: god
commands.help: Toggle protection for all of your controllable runtime entities, or explicitly use /god on or /god off.

saveCommands.name: save
saveCommands.help: Write a manual slot. Slot numbers are positive whole decimals without leading zeros.

saveCommands.name: load
saveCommands.summary: Restore a saved campaign on its recorded map.
saveCommands.help: Use /saves to identify existing slots. Autosaves are 1 through 15. /load N is the manual shorthand. /load retry resumes a durable recovery after interrupted startup. Rejected loads preserve the active campaign and source saves.

saveCommands.name: saves
saveCommands.help: List saved map IDs for all 15 autosaves, both checkpoints and a window of 10 manual slots. The default manual window starts at 1; /saves manual N starts at N. Missing slots are omitted. Listing never writes saves.
